title: Collider

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Enable or disable collisions on items

body:
"Enables and disables collisions with filled schematics, privacy glass, vehicle/trailer pads, and spawn pads within the world."

The Collider is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It is used to disable/enable object collisions.

Functionality

The collider enables or disables the object in its region. Players can change the size and position of the region to wherever they want. Any object, such as a filled schematic that touches the region will gain/lose its ability to collide with other objects, allowing for things such as hidden doorways, filtering objects and more.
